Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.integration.openlineage.postgres

Class PostgresOpenLineageEventDigest

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.integration.openlineage.postgres.PostgresOpenLineageEventDigest
public class PostgresOpenLineageEventDigest extends Object
PostgresOpenLineageEventDigest extracts the rows that an OpenLineage run event contributes to the digest tables of a PostgreSQL OpenLineage log store (see PostgresOpenLineageLogStoreSchema). It holds no database code, so the extraction can be tested on its own.

      public static PostgresOpenLineageEventDigest digest(OpenLineageRunEvent event)
      Return the digest of an event, or null if the event can not be stored because it has no job name, run identifier or readable event time.

    • parseTimestamp

      public static Date parseTimestamp(String timestamp)
      Parse an ISO-8601 timestamp from an OpenLineage event. Timestamps without a zone are treated as UTC.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      date or null if the timestamp is missing or unparsable
